desc: Develop and run a small exhaustive-search checker for short Dyck words and compare reachable orbit sizes against the unordered-tree embedding formula.
Prove the tree/forest interpretation of the operation and precisely characterize that arbitrary sibling permutations and independent recursive reorderings are reachable.
Derive the counting formula for distinct ordered embeddings of the invariant unordered rooted forest, including repeated isomorphic child types.
Build and implement the final deterministic bottom-up canonical-ID parser and modular counting algorithm for \(N\le5000\).
Review edge cases: primitive blocks, top-level forests, nested chains, and repeated isomorphic substructures.
